fact: Meeting the mayors of the communes of the District of Bamako and of Kati on 30 July 2026, the minister of territorial administration said digital payments at civil-status centres had generated nearly 200 million FCFA between July 2024 and May 2026 and were now a strict obligation at civil-status centres and mairies, while participants reported unsuitable telephones, failing operator alerts and a need for better network coverage, and the minister asked for a report on incidents and equipment needs within thirty days.
title: Bamako et Kati : Dans la dynamique de la modernisation des services municipaux
